user.title: Feedparser
user.description: Create a sensor from an RSS/Atom feed. Refresh and parsing options can be changed later.

data_description.name: Friendly name for the sensor.
data_description.feed_url: RSS or Atom feed URL. HTTP, HTTPS, and local file URLs are supported.
data_description.date_format: Python strftime format used for feed dates, for example `%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %Z`.
data_description.local_time: Convert feed timestamps to Home Assistant's configured local time before formatting.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to refresh the feed. The minimum interval is 1 minute.
data_description.show_topn: Maximum number of entries exposed in the `entries` attribute. Large values increase state size.
data_description.remove_summary_image: Strip `` tags from the `summary` field. This does not remove a separate `image` field.
data_description.inclusions: Optional comma-separated allowlist, for example `title, link, published`. Leave empty to keep all fields except exclusions.
data_description.exclusions: Optional comma-separated fields to remove. Exclusions are applied after inclusions.

error.scan_interval_too_short: Refresh interval must be at least 1 minute.
